Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:



Haunting and Lunatic Eruption get stuck on the minion in question;
they would be controlled by you, and therefore remain on your guys.

Brainwash and Pentex are masters, and therefore go away when your
predator goes away.

Not to mention I'm not sure how you were able to deflect your
predator's bleeds back to him, unless your predator was deflecting
bleeds from HIS predator to you in the first place.

=)

-- Derek

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>When my predator was outsed all cards controlled by him were burnt,
>including the hauntings and lunatic eruptions unless I'm missing something
>here.

Cards like The Haunting and Lunatic Eruption are minion cards and placed on the
particular minion. That means they are controlled by the controller of the
vampire (not the Methusaleh who played them).

Thus even after he's ousted, The Haunting and Lunatic Eruption, and other such
cards are still in play because *he* doesn't control them.

Halcyan 2
